metadata.description: Atom11 for Claude: Amazon Ads and retail reports, audits, charts and approved campaign changes, built on your own Atom11 data.

plugins.name: atom11
plugins.description:
Run your Amazon Ads and retail work from a conversation, on your own Atom11 data.

Ask in plain words and Claude builds the answer from your Atom11 numbers: weekly and monthly business reviews, full account audits, campaign rankings against your target ACOS, search terms to harvest or block, restock and out-of-stock risks, and charts of any metric over time. Reports come as clean HTML pages you can save or share.

It works across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, DSP and retail data. Every number comes from your Atom11 account, and each skill says when data is missing, late or only partly covered.

Reading is the default. When you ask for a change to a bid, budget, status or negative, Claude shows the full preview first and applies it only after you say yes. The deep audit page puts a Take action button beside each recommended change, with Undo where Atom11 supports it.

Needs an Atom11 account and the Atom11 connector.
